notes: Independent 4-lane review round (architect, correctness-critic, security, test-evidence) over a389e81..33b9f31 — the entire unreviewed candidate range: the Bun<=1.3.13 WritableStream-leak root-cause fix (runtime floor 1.3.14, stream-retention falsifier), soak sampler committed-memory/heap-type instrumentation, the SOAK_COMMITTED_ABORT_MB breaker, the full 1.3.9 support-surface drop, the evidence-only rebind commit, and the trivy-action bump. Verdicts: ZERO P0 in every lane; 1 P1 (user-facing disclosure of the runtime leak hazard) and all distinct P2 (9), P3 (8), and P4 (~9) findings were fixed in commits 8498ddf, b2a1b82, 61e4c37, and 875dfbf and re-verified at this candidate by the full local gate set recorded alongside (packages 530+1skip/531 across 68 files, wasm 96/96, parity 71+71 zero-skip, playwright 21+7+1, doc-truth, tsc, soak-addon 23/23 including the new bunVersionAtLeast and aggregate-floor tests). Highlights: the committed-memory metric now GATES segment verdicts (it was forensics-only); the in-loop breaker flushes a partial artifact instead of throwing into an unawaited promise; aggregation refuses segments recorded on leaking runtimes; the stream-retention falsifier was hardened against vacuity and empirically re-verified to fail on Bun 1.3.9 and pass on 1.3.14; the library now warns once at runtime on leaking Bun versions because engines.bun is advisory. The security lane independently verified the trivy-action pin is the genuine v0.36.0 (annotated-tag SHA dereferencing to ed142fd, since repinned to the commit SHA per repo convention). Root-cause evidence for the underlying runtime leak (A/B repro, version bisect, 1.3.9 positive control with 45,831 live WritableStreams, 2h Bun-1.3.14 PASS verification) is preserved under docs/release-evidence/bun-writablestream-leak-2026-08-08/.
